summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel-use@13.2.12 ships a package.json preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs an obfuscated dropper. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, unzips it to a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and then invokes `execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js])`. The invoked math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and uses aggressive string-array obfuscation (rotating decoder with a several-hundred-entry constant table, randomized identifiers). An ESLint shared-config package has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute an obfuscated bundle at install time, and the declared upstream repository (ornikar/eslint-configs) does not ship these files. index.js contains a normal airbnb-based ESLint config that serves as cover for the two dropper files. The combination of ecosystem-mismatched runtime fetch, obfuscated dropper, and obfuscated payload executed automatically on `npm install` is a supply-chain compromise of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
